name: QQ's Wood
old_description: Immerse yourself in the beauty of bespoke woodcraft, right here in the heart of Honolulu, Hawaii. At QQ's Wood Shop, we blend the serene essence of the islands with unparalleled craftsmanship to bring you custom furniture and unique gifts.
about:
QQ's Wood operates from a workshop in Honolulu, Hawaii. The business began when QQ, an engineer by training, turned a woodworking hobby into a full-time pursuit as a bespoke wood artisan. No founding year is disclosed.

The shop produces custom furniture, display cases, cutting boards, coasters, bowls, pens, gift boxes, and carved urns, all handcrafted using Hawaiian Koa, mahogany, and other sustainably sourced hardwoods. Processes include hand turning, hand carving, custom design, and food-safe finishing. The workshop also restores antique furniture and family heirlooms. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are published.

Clients range from individuals seeking one-of-a-kind furniture or gifts to families entrusting heirloom restoration. The company serves residential and gift markets, with projects including custom-fit furniture for homes and offices, commemorative urns, and personalized gift boxes.

QQ emphasizes a blend of technical precision and artistic flair drawn from an engineering background, and a collaborative approach that translates client visions into tangible pieces. The founder cites dedication to quality and passion for the craft as driving forces.
